turns.question: Which country had the lowest average daily order revenue from 17 August to 2 October 2026, counting days with no orders from that country as zero and excluding cancelled orders, and what was that average?
turns.answer: US had the lowest revenue over 17 August to 2 October 2026 at 1498.25 EUR (Revenue (EUR), non-cancelled orders, a total for the whole period, not a daily average): the semantic layer has no average-daily-revenue metric, so I could not give the per-day figure, and the closest metric is Revenue (EUR) by customer country. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
